people.name: Alemeth
people.line: Son of Jehoaddah, a Benjamite from Gibeon

people.name: Azmaveth
people.line: Descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah

people.name: Moza
people.line: Son of Zimri, descendant of King Saul

translations.web: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
translations.bsb: Ahaz was the father of Jarah; Jarah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza.
translations.kjv: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
translations.asv: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
